pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
Specializes in dodging and teleport-strikes. Powerful in the End.

HP: 120. Regen IV + Resistance II.

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
67% melee dodge, 100% projectile dodge (teleport-evades).

Melee/Archer mode fires dragon's breath (lingering cloud, 3s cooldown). Does not harm owner or allies.

Execute: teleport-strikes targets below 25% HP (60s cooldown). With Ender Axe: threshold rises to 55%.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text: Craft the Ender Doll Head, then the Ender Doll Egg. Name the egg on an anvil to summon.
